title: Malicious code in elisa_downloader (npm)
description: The elisa_downloader npm package contains malicious code that compromises any computer on which it is installed or running. The compromise is severe enough that all secrets and keys stored on the affected system should be rotated immediately from a different, secure computer. Removal of the package does not guarantee elimination of all malicious software, as the attacker may have gained full control of the system.
